# netactuate_server_options (Resource)

Updates mutable options on an existing cloud server. The API has no delete endpoint for server options, so deleting this resource removes it from Terraform state only and leaves the server options unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_server_options" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose options should be managed.

### Optional

- `autorescue` (Number) Autorescue value to set.
- `boot` (String) Server boot option to set.
- `description` (String) Server description to set.
- `fqdn` (String) Server hostname to set.
- `kernel_id` (Number) Server kernel ID to set.
- `vcpus` (Number) Server vCPU count to set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by the last update call.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_server_options.example 12345
```
